name: evidence-based-research

en.description: Research a consequential question or compare options using current multi-source evidence, explicit confidence, contradictions, and a decision-ready brief.

zh-CN.description: 综合当前的多来源证据，区分事实、推断、分歧和未知，形成可用于决策的研究简报。

runtime: Web or repository research tools when needed

stableBlockers: Run baseline comparison on at least five real decisions
Measure citation support and contradiction-detection rates
